title: Avocado Imports at Risk as US Halts Government Work in Michoacán
summary: The US suspended government activities in the Mexican state of Michoacán, affecting imports of avocados from the largest producing region in the country to the US.

title: CME, FanDuel Venture Falters as Prediction Startups Race Ahead
summary: CME Group Inc. and FanDuel are scaling back a joint effort to take on prediction market startups after failing to gain traction in a booming industry that has quickly come to represent a threat to both Wall Street exchanges and traditional sportsbooks.

title: Gold Jumps Most Since February on Hormuz, Technical Breakout
summary: Gold jumped the most since February as prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, while a break above a key technical resistance level fueled additional buying.

title: Stocks Edge Lower as Rate Hike Rumbles Offset Nvidia’s Rally
summary: US stocks closed little changed on Wednesday, erasing an earlier climb, after Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari’s comment that it’s time for the central bank to start slowly raising rates. Megacap Nvidia Corp. extended its rally to a fifth day, boosted by confidence in artificial-intelligence related spending. The stock contributed the most to the S&P 500 Index on a points basis Wednesday.

title: EU Audit Offers Brazil’s Poultry Exports a Path Around Ban
summary: The European Union will carry out an audit in Brazil at the end of August that could allow the country’s poultry exports to avoid a ban due to take effect on Sept. 3.

title: Zillow’s Revenue Jumps as Rentals Offer ‘Bright Spot’
summary: Zillow Group Inc. said Wednesday that second-quarter revenue jumped 18% from a year earlier to $772 million, as the online real estate company sees rental agreements growing more quickly than home purchases on its website and app.

title: Blue Owl BDCs Buy Back $90 Million of Shares to Support Value

title: Dorsey’s Block Boosts Profit Outlook as Revamp Takes Shape
summary: Block Inc. lifted its annual profit guidance on Wednesday after delivering quarterly results that topped expectations due to growth in both its Square and Cash App businesses.

title: Kalshi Not Running 'a Casino' Says Head of Enforcement
summary: Robert DeNault, Kalshi's head of enforcement and legal counsel, responded to a lawsuit brought New York State, saying that he is concerned about overreach coming from Attorney General Letitia James's office. DeNault defended Kalshi's operations saying that his company is platforming open marketplaces, not functioning as a casino or a sportsbook.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Signals Steady Debt Sales to 2027, Offers ‘Subtle’ Change
summary: The US Treasury on Wednesday retained its previous guidance for future debt issuance, signaling no change in note and bond auction sizes well into 2027 even as federal borrowing needs climb.
